## revision_2 (2026-10-23)

### source_to_kb (changed atoms only)
- S-1 closure. Two new source sentences:
  - The ETF replaced_by now reads "… a fee that comes to zero being recorded with the notice and not billed …".
  - The rule adds "Where the early termination fee comes to zero, the termination notice is recorded and no early_termination_fee line is billed, a line that comes to zero not being billed."
  
  The tool body now returns early when `amt == 0` and creates no line, with a zero receipt ("… no early termination fee is billed; program charges owed now …"). Both sentences, the tool effect and the zero receipt are carried in written_termination_notice ("Billing of the fee", "Giving the notice", "Return"). This is now consistent with the in-force monthly_program_invoice clause "A line that comes to zero is not billed".
- New de minimis (from policy revisions 4 and 5):
  - The shortfall rule adds "A late charge is booked on a shortfall notice only where the notice has an open amount of at least the de minimis amount, deminimis_open_usd; …" (25.0). Compute: `result … if (in_scope and open_amt >= K('deminimis_open_usd')) else 0`. KB: shortfall_notice_late_charge_computation "De minimis amount" plus a hypothetical worked row (open 20.00 → none). Equivalent.
  - The return policy's prerequisite policy_source is now "… that schedule carries no remittance return, and the notice has an open amount of at least the de minimis amount, that notice carries the late charge owed …". The script check confirms it is verbatim in reinstated_schedule_prior_late_charges and in no other document. The doc renders the return policy's own deminimis_open_usd as "The de minimis amount is 25.00 US dollars", and its same-form restatement carries "open by at least 25.00 US dollars". The state form and "only after" are intact. The resolution basis is unchanged: the shortfall docs, now including the de minimis, say when the shortfall late charge is booked, in the same words.
  - The termination prerequisite sentence is unchanged and still verbatim and single-homed in written_termination_notice.
- S-3 closure (this task's policies). The month-end clause is now in the rules and docs for liable frequency, prior charges (both policies), liable history, returned payments, termination fee lines, contract year and breach relief (repeated_liable_shortfall_rate_loading, shortfall_prior_late_charge_points, reinstated_schedule_prior_late_charges, reinstated_schedule_liable_shortfall_history, returned_payment_history_charge_form, termination_fee_monthly_charge_lines, contract_year_termination_step_down, service_breach_termination_relief). It agrees with `MONTHS`/`within_months`, including the 29 February example (counts through 28 February of the next year, drops out on 1 March). The only docs that say "whole month" without the clause are part_month_per_worker_billing and payroll_card_bundle_platform_discount, and there it means "the whole month is billed", not a count.
